Documentation ｜ Blog ｜ Roadmap ｜ Issue Tracker ｜ Email Support

AstrBot is an open-source all-in-one Agent chatbot platform that integrates with mainstream instant messaging apps. It provides reliable and scalable conversational AI infrastructure for individuals, developers, and teams. Whether you're building a personal AI companion, intelligent customer service, automation assistant, or enterprise knowledge base, AstrBot enables you to quickly build production-ready AI applications within your IM platform workflows.

Key Features

  1. 💯 Free & Open Source.
  2. ✨ AI LLM Conversations, Multimodal, Agent, MCP, Skills, Knowledge Base, Persona Settings, Auto Context Compression.
  3. 🤖 Supports integration with Dify, Alibaba Cloud Bailian, Coze, and other agent platforms.
  4. 🌐 Multi-Platform: QQ, WeChat Work, Feishu, DingTalk, WeChat Official Accounts, Telegram, Slack, and more.
  5. 📦 Plugin Extensions with 1000+ plugins available for one-click installation.
  6. 🛡️ Agent Sandbox for isolated, safe execution of code, shell calls, and session-level resource reuse.
  7. 💻 WebUI Support.
  8. 🌈 Web ChatUI Support with built-in agent sandbox and web search.
  9. 🌐 Internationalization (i18n) Support.

Quick Start

One-Click Cloud Deployment (RainYun)

For users who want one-click 24-hour-online deployment and do not want to manage servers themselves, we recommend RainYun's one-click cloud deployment service ☁️:

One-Click Deployment

Note

Requires uv to be installed. For macOS users: due to macOS security checks, the first run of the astrbot command may take longer (about 10-20s).

For users who want to quickly experience AstrBot, are familiar with command-line usage, and can install a uv environment on their own, we recommend the uv one-click deployment method ⚡️:

uv tool install astrbot --python 3.12
astrbot init # Only execute this command for the first time to initialize the environment
astrbot run

Update astrbot:

uv tool upgrade astrbot --python 3.12

Docker Deployment

For users familiar with containers and looking for a more stable, production-ready deployment method, we recommend deploying AstrBot with Docker / Docker Compose.

Please refer to the official documentation: Deploy AstrBot with Docker.

Desktop Application Deployment

For users who want to use AstrBot on desktop and mainly use ChatUI, we recommend AstrBot App.

Visit AstrBot-desktop to download and install; this method is designed for desktop usage and is not recommended for server scenarios.

Launcher Deployment

For desktop users who also want fast deployment and isolated multi-instance usage, we recommend AstrBot Launcher.

Visit AstrBot Launcher to download and install.

More deployment methods

If you need panel-based management or deeper customization, see BT-Panel Deployment for BT Panel app-store setup, 1Panel Deployment for 1Panel app-market deployment, CasaOS Deployment for NAS/home-server visual deployment, and Manual Deployment for fully custom source-based installation with uv.

❤️ Contributing

Issues and Pull Requests are always welcome! Feel free to submit your changes to this project :)

How to Contribute

You can contribute by reviewing issues or helping with pull request reviews. Any issues or PRs are welcome to encourage community participation. Of course, these are just suggestions—you can contribute in any way you like. For adding new features, please discuss through an Issue first.

Development Environment

AstrBot uses ruff for code formatting and linting.

git clone https://github.com/AstrBotDevs/AstrBot
pip install pre-commit
pre-commit install

⭐ Star History

Tip

If this project has helped you in your life or work, or if you're interested in its future development, please give the project a Star. It's the driving force behind maintaining this open-source project <3

Companionship and capability should never be at odds. What we aim to create is a robot that can understand emotions, provide genuine companionship, and reliably accomplish tasks.

releases.body:
## [4.29.1] - 2026-10-17

### 新增

- 网页搜索：“网页搜索” 能力新增 [SerpApi 搜索服务](https://serpapi.com/) (Google 网页搜索、图片搜索、学术搜索、财经搜索)、[DeepSeek 搜索服务](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/guides/search/)（网页搜索、网页内容提取）。 (#10599)
- 插件开发：为插件的单选/多选配置项（list 类型）添加本地化的 `subtitles` 副标题元数据。


### 修复

- ‼️ 电脑使用：修复部分环境（如 Docker 容器环境）下，本地隔离不可用时，无法保存 Local 权限的问题。(#10584)
- 电脑使用：恢复 Windows 下工作区范围内的文件读取、写入和编辑，通过原生文件句柄检查拒绝重解析点和硬链接别名。 (#10584)
- Core：修复开启 “会话隔离” 功能后可能造成的内存泄漏。在注册消息处理流水线之前完成群聊会话隔离，确保运行中的任务及停止请求使用正确的会话。 (#10581)
- Telegram：转换消息时保留隐藏链接。 (#10557)
- Discord：修复全体成员提及。 (#10563)
- WebUI：修复移动端点击插件视图信息后浮层立即关闭的问题。 (#10562)
- Edge TTS：保留原生客户端的 User-Agent，避免请求失败。 (#10588)
- Skills：跳过无法读取的本地及插件技能目录，避免单个目录异常导致整轮 Agent 请求失败。 (#10591)

### Added

- Web Search: Added SerpApi (Google Search, Google Image Search, Google Scholar Search and Google Finance Search) and DeepSeek Search API (web search and page content extraction). (#10599)
- Plugin development: Added localized subtitle metadata for single-select/multi-select configuration options (of type 'list') in plugins.

### Fixed

- ‼️ Computer Use: Restored workspace-scoped file reading, writing, and editing on Windows. Native handle checks r

releases.name: v4.29.0
releases.body:
## [4.29.0] - 2026-10-14

This release includes all changes from **v4.29.0-beta.1** and **v4.29.0-beta.2**, plus changes since **v4.29.0-beta.2**. The full release range starts at **v4.28.0**.

### Major Additions

- Computer Use: Added OS-specific sandbox support for the local execution environment, available on macOS with Seatbelt and Linux with bubblewrap only. Please refer to: https://docs.astrbot.app/use/astrbot-agent-sandbox.html (#9472)
- ChatUI: Added chat history and sidebar session pagination, persistent input drafts, per-session model selection, and input autofocus when switching projects. (#9667, #10279, #10247, #10301)
- ChatUI: Added provider source filters and sticky groups to model selection, plus search on the Skills and MCP pages. (#10084, #10217)
- Text-to-image settings have **moved from Settings to Configuration Profiles → Extensions** and are now configured separately for each profile.
- Administrator and whitelist settings have moved from **Configuration Profiles → Platform** to **Configuration Profiles → Access Control**. (#10321)
- WebUI: Added a workspace directory picker and update download progress in the desktop app. (#10222, #10227, #10050)

## [4.29.0-beta.2] - 2026-10-11

This prerelease includes changes since **v4.29.0-beta.1**.

### Major Additions

- WebUI: Added model settings shortcuts beside selected models and in model/fallback menus. Changes save immediately for every configuration profile using that model. (#10321)
- WebUI: Added console log search and keyword highlighting, source badges for Skills, staged image previews in ChatUI, and remembered the last opened Data & Logs tab. (#10327, #10339, #10376, #10251)
- WebUI: Added configuration profile editing in a side drawer from the bot editor. (#10310)
- Docker: Included the `astrbot` CLI for password reset inside containers. (#10442)

- WebUI: Kept content borders and corners fixed while scrolling, added 6px desktop right/bottom gaps, and pinned configuration/settings headers and section navigation while the content pane scrolls. (#10480)
- Computer Use: Clarified local permission access modes, kept execution and file access controls visible when local isol

releases.name: v4.28.2
releases.body:
## [4.28.2] - 2026-09-27

### Fixes

- Fixed SQLite datetime fields being inferred as SQLModel `UTCDateTime` after dependency upgrades, which caused knowledge-base writes, dashboard statistics, and related database operations to fail for naive datetime values. (#10205, #10212, #10255)
- Fixed platform message-history cleanup using a local-time cutoff instead of UTC, which could leave records undeleted on hosts outside UTC. (#10255)

## 中文

### 修复

- 修复 SQLModel 依赖升级后 SQLite 时间字段被推断为 `UTCDateTime`，导致知识库写入、Dashboard 统计及相关数据库操作因 naive datetime 失败的问题。 (#10205, #10212, #10255)
- 修复平台消息历史清理使用本地时间计算截止时间的问题，避免非 UTC 主机上出现消息未被删除的情况。 (#10255)

[4.28.2]: https://github.com/AstrBotDevs/AstrBot/compare/v4.28.1...v4.28.2

aiSummary.oneLiner: A multi-platform AI chatbot framework supporting QQ, WeChat, and Telegram with rich plugin capabilities.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: AstrBot is a flexible conversational AI framework designed to connect large language models to various instant messaging platforms. It acts as a bridge between LLM providers (like OpenAI, Claude, or local models) and social networks including QQ, WeChat, Telegram, and Discord. The framework supports a robust plugin ecosystem, allowing developers to extend bot functionality with features like web search, image generation, or custom API integrations. It emphasizes ease of deployment and extensive configuration options for community management and personal assistance. Its extensible architecture supports numerous plugins, allowing developers to customize responses and capabilities easily across IM platforms.
keyFeatures: Multi-Platform Support: Connects seamlessly to QQ, WeChat, Telegram, Discord, and other messaging networks.
LLM Integration: Supports various AI models including OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and local deployments.
Plugin Architecture: Extensible system for adding custom commands, tools, and automated behaviors.
Visual Configuration: Provides a web-based dashboard for easy management of bot settings and active plugins.
Docker Deployment: Offers simple containerized deployment options for quick setup and scaling.
IM Compatibility: Natively hooks into major instant messaging platforms for seamless bot deployment.
